name: Moultrie flag

colors.symbolism: the blue of the South Carolina militia uniforms

description: A navy blue field with a white crescent in the upper hoist bearing the word 'LIBERTY'.
history: Designed by Colonel William Moultrie in 1775 for the South Carolina troops; it flew over the palmetto-log fort on Sullivan's Island during the British attack of 28 June 1776, where Sergeant William Jasper famously raised it again under fire. It is the ancestor of the modern South Carolina state flag.
